blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — A new 50-room hotel has opened in Tacloban City, adding to the city’s accommodation capacity and providing employment opportunities for residents as it seeks to strengthen its position as a business and tourism center in Eastern Visayas. Mayor Alfred Romualdez welcomed the opening of Cevio Hotel on Sunday, Nov. 22, saying the decision of its owners to invest in the city was encouraging amid what he described as sluggish economic conditions. “I am delighted that Cevio Hotel is here with a five-star standard at a time when there are few investors willing to put up businesses.
